title: VACA R16 Anti-Fence Clean Corpus
subtitle: 613 clean anti-fence rows — R10-15 re-filtered + verified generations
description: Round-16 remediation corpus for VACA. Rounds 10-14 (the deployed R15 model's lineage, all run on Kaggle) contained training rows whose OUTPUT was markdown-fenced, batched chat format — the exact failure signature in VACA's generated source files. This corpus keeps ONLY rows that pass the same poison gate the VACA app uses (isQualityCode): no ``` fences, no --- separators, no prompt artifacts, no prose explanations, no stub bodies. Clean rows from R10-R14 are new signal (their fence-free form was never trained); R15 clean rows are retention; verified-generations.jsonl (tsc-gated) is added. 552 train / 61 val rows, seq-3072 budget-guarded.
